author: Charisma Tandy
text: My Tandem Control IQ is still trying to figure me out! Most mornings it's been taking my basal rate down to 0.0 at the 1 hour post meal mark. Today, it reacted quickly to the rise post meal and gave a small correction bolus. An hour later I was at 54!! Now it will probably pull back basal again and I'll be high at lunch time. I try not to worry it too much as the algorithm is attempting to adjust. 👀

author: Integration Loop Health
text: Charisma Tandy t definitely sounds frustrating. ❤️ One thing to keep in mind is that Control-IQ isn’t actually “learning” your insulin needs over time—it makes decisions based on your current CGM trends and the pump settings you’ve programmed. A drop to 54 mg/dL after an auto-correction may be a clue that something like the insulin sensitivity factor, carb ratio, or even meal timing could use a closer look. It may be worth reviewing those settings with your diabetes team if these lows keep happening.
